# 2. Problems

## Problem 1. Giant kelp fronds

### a. An appropriate test

Because we are interested in the strength of the relationship between temperature and giant kelp
frond elongation rate, the appropriate test is a Pearson’s r or a Spearman rank correlation. These tests both test for correlation between two variables and see haw the variables move together, not necessarily predict each other. Pearson’s r test is a parametric test that can be used for continuous and normally distributed variables. Spearman rank correlation is a non-parametric test, which can be used for interval, ordinal, or nominal data.
